_note: Synthetic demo inbox. timeline[0] = day of the initial plan (Lumen announces new bank details: policy exception); timeline[1] = new information (Acme delay contradicts the receipt forecast). The 2026-10-30 message is after both and must be ignored.

messages.subject: Remittance advice AR-5531
messages.text: Good morning. Acme Retail Ltd will transfer USD 10,000 for invoice AR-5531 to your Airwallex account tomorrow morning by ACH. Please treat this email as our remittance advice for the October statement.

messages.subject: Warehouse maintenance
messages.text: Rheinwerk Komponenten reminds all customers that the Frankfurt warehouse will be closed for maintenance next Friday afternoon. Orders placed before noon will still ship on schedule.

messages.subject: Updated payment details
messages.text: Hello accounts team, please note that Lumen Design Studio has changed banks and our account details are updated. Kindly send the payment for invoice LD-77 to our new bank account from today, and disregard the account on the invoice.

messages.subject: RE: Remittance advice AR-5531
messages.text: Hi team, because of an internal approval hold, the Acme Retail Ltd payment of USD 10,000 for invoice AR-5531 will be delayed by five days. We apologise for the inconvenience and will confirm by email as soon as the transfer is released.

messages.subject: Payment released AR-5531
messages.text: Good news: Acme Retail Ltd has released the payment for invoice AR-5531 today and the transfer should arrive within one business day.
